$comment: RAW OUTPUT OF scripts/scan/scan.mjs. Not for direct publication.
axe-core detects a SUBSET of WCAG failures. A page with no detected
violations is not necessarily conformant. Never publish a named site.
Sites that could not be measured are retained above, and the
denominator disclosure below must ship with any figure derived here.

sample.frame: Tranco list 645ZX, generated 15 August 2026 from crux, farsight, majestic, radar and umbrella over 17 July to 15 August 2026, Dowdall combination, pay-level-domain filtered. Ranks 10,001 to 60,000, every 100th domain, giving 500 candidates. REPRODUCIBLE: the list is permanent at https://tranco-list.eu/list/645ZX and the selection rule is arithmetic, so anyone can rebuild this exact set. THE RANK BAND IS DELIBERATE: above 10,000 is dominated by platforms, CDNs and infrastructure domains that have no transactional page at all; below 60,000 the parked-domain and dead-site rate climbs. THE POPULATION IS DEFINED BY THE FILTER, NOT BY HAND. Many of these 500 are government portals, CDNs or country-code Google domains with nothing to measure. They are NOT removed from the sample: they stay in the denominator and are reported as noIntentPageFound. The study is therefore about 'sites in this band that have a discoverable contact, booking, quote or demo page', which is a stated population rather than a curated one. Removing them by judgement would make the set unreproducible and the yield unreportable.
